children: Blue Acquisition entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion to adjust earnout and warrant terms ahead of closing. The amendment lifts the maximum earnout to 15,000,000 Pubco Class A shares, vesting in three tranches at $13.00, $15.00 and $17.00 VWAP thresholds measured over 20 of 30 trading days. It also provides for the automatic cancellation of the CoreWeave warrant before the effective time and issuance by Pubco of a replacement warrant for 2,870,813 Pubco Class A shares at a $7.4643 initial exercise price, subject to adjustment. All other BCA terms remain in effect.
